p: Beeston is one of Nottingham's busiest suburbs, with the University of Nottingham's main campus just up the road, so the High Road gets a lively mix of students, shoppers and locals right through the day.

Admiral itself is a straightforward 18+ slots shop, not a family arcade, so if you've got the kids in tow they'll need to be doing something else. The good news is that the tram makes life easy. NET trams run through Beeston and on into Nottingham city centre, so you can leave the car behind and hop between the High Road, the Square and town without fretting about parking. Plenty of cafés and takeaways line the street if you want a bite before or after.
